description: Responsive design makes a page fit the space available. A phone and a large monitor can show the same useful content in different layouts. Learn flexible boxes, readable text and simple screen rules. Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.
versionNote: Uses modern CSS Grid, Flexbox, media queries and size container queries.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to resize the page and watch the side space
Learn to add two more cards and compare narrow and wide views
Learn to replace the word with a long sample address
learningObjectives: Learn to resize the page and watch the side space
